Descriptor: Exceeds Expectations: Demonstrates exceptional understanding and application, showing insight and creativity.
Academic Descriptor: Advanced Understanding: Mastery of concepts with ability to apply in novel contexts.,Leadership: Consistently takes initiative
Project-Based Descriptor: Innovative Approach: Incorporates outstanding, original ideas and executes them effectively.

Descriptor: Meets Expectations: Solid understanding and application, work is complete and accurate.
Academic Descriptor: Proficient Understanding: Good grasp of concepts with correct application.
Behavioral Descriptor: Participation: Actively engages in all activities, collaborates effectively.
Project-Based Descriptor: Accomplished Execution: Project is well-constructed, showing good planning and effort.

Descriptor: Approaching Expectations: Basic understanding but with some inaccuracies or incomplete aspects.
Academic Descriptor: Basic Understanding: Shows understanding of simple concepts but struggles with complexity.
Behavioral Descriptor: Developing Participation: Participates but may be inconsistent, sometimes needs encouragement.
Project-Based Descriptor: Developing Project Skills: Project shows effort but lacks depth or detail.

Descriptor: Below Expectations: Minimal understanding with significant inaccuracies.
Academic Descriptor: Limited Understanding: Work shows a lack of comprehension of basic concepts.
Behavioral Descriptor: Reluctant Participation: Rarely participates or needs constant reminders.
Project-Based Descriptor: Beginning Stages: Project is incomplete or fails to meet basic requirements.
